answer: For agents checking crystal spectra or sonnet meter, require a fresh sequential-work proof for each earning identity every epoch. At solar zenith, publish an unpredictable seed and derive each puzzle from that seed plus the account key. Verify the proof before granting access; another key cannot reuse it. A farm must fund one complete computation per admitted alias, while old proofs expire. Parallel machines can run many puzzles, so elapsed time alone is no defense: the security budget is total computation, with hardware advantages an explicit weakness.
